/* selectSystemLogTotalCount - Lee JiSeob */
SELECT
COUNT(*) AS CNT
FROM (
SELECT
D.URL_ADDR, D.CLSSA_NM, D.METHDA_NM, D.SYS_PRCS_SE_CD, D.PRCS_HR, D.MENU_NM, D.UP_MENU_NM, D.PROGRM_ID, D.DMND_IP_ADDR, D.FRST_RGTR_ID,
D.FRST_REG_DT,
C##RG.SA_FN_GET_NAME(D.FRST_RGTR_ID) AS FRST_RGTR_NM
FROM SAB920 D /* 시스템 로그 */
) C
AND C.URL_ADDR LIKE '%' || #{URL_ADDR} || '%'
AND C.CLSSA_NM LIKE '%' || #{CLSSA_NM} || '%'
AND C.METHDA_NM LIKE '%' || #{METHDA_NM} || '%'
AND C.MENU_NM LIKE '%' || #{MENU_NM} || '%'
AND C.PROGRM_ID LIKE '%' || #{PROGRM_ID} || '%'
AND C.DMND_IP_ADDR LIKE '%' || #{DMND_IP_ADDR} || '%'
AND C.FRST_RGTR_ID = #{FRST_RGTR_ID}
AND C.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DATE} || ' 00:00:00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
AND C.FRST_REG_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DATE} || ' 23:59:59', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
AND C.SYS_PRCS_SE_CD = #{SYS_PRCS_SE_CD}

/* selectSystemLog - Lee JiSeob */
SELECT SEQ, URL_ADDR, CLSSA_NM, METHDA_NM, SYS_PRCS_SE_CD, PRCS_HR, MENU_NM, UP_MENU_NM, PROGRM_ID, DMND_IP_ADDR, FRST_RGTR_ID, TO_CHAR(FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS FRST_REG_DT, FRST_RGTR_NM, SRCH_FACTR_CN FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM AS SEQ, URL_ADDR, CLSSA_NM, METHDA_NM, SYS_PRCS_SE_CD, PRCS_HR, MENU_NM, UP_MENU_NM, PROGRM_ID, DMND_IP_ADDR, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_REG_DT, FRST_RGTR_NM, SRCH_FACTR_CN FROM ( SELECT
C.URL_ADDR, C.CLSSA_NM, C.METHDA_NM, C.SYS_PRCS_SE_CD, C.PRCS_HR, C.MENU_NM, C.UP_MENU_NM, C.PROGRM_ID, C.DMND_IP_ADDR, C.FRST_RGTR_ID,
C.FRST_REG_DT,
C.FRST_RGTR_NM,
C.SRCH_FACTR_CN
FROM ( SELECT
D.URL_ADDR, D.CLSSA_NM, D.METHDA_NM, D.SYS_PRCS_SE_CD, D.PRCS_HR, D.MENU_NM, D.UP_MENU_NM, D.PROGRM_ID, D.DMND_IP_ADDR, D.FRST_RGTR_ID,
D.FRST_REG_DT,
C##RG.DEC_B64(C##RG.SA_FN_GET_NAME(D.FRST_RGTR_ID)) AS FRST_RGTR_NM,
D.SRCH_FACTR_CN
FROM SAB920 D /* 시스템 로그 */
) C
AND C.URL_ADDR LIKE '%' || #{URL_ADDR} || '%'
AND C.CLSSA_NM LIKE '%' || #{CLSSA_NM} || '%'
AND C.METHDA_NM LIKE '%' || #{METHDA_NM} || '%'
AND C.MENU_NM LIKE '%' || #{MENU_NM} || '%'
AND C.PROGRM_ID LIKE '%' || #{PROGRM_ID} || '%'
AND C.DMND_IP_ADDR LIKE '%' || #{DMND_IP_ADDR} || '%'
AND C.FRST_RGTR_ID = #{FRST_RGTR_ID}
AND C.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DATE} || ' 00:00:00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
AND C.FRST_REG_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DATE} || ' 23:59:59', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
AND C.SYS_PRCS_SE_CD = #{SYS_PRCS_SE_CD}
ORDER BY C.FRST_REG_DT DESC ) X1 ) X2 WHERE SEQ >= #{START_IDX} AND SEQ <= #{LAST_IDX}

/* selectLogInOutLogTotalCount - Lee JiSeob */
SELECT
COUNT(*) AS CNT
FROM (
SELECT D.CNTN_IP_ADDR, D.LGN_LGT_SE_CD, D.FRST_RGTR_ID, C##RG.DEC_B64(C##RG.SA_FN_GET_NAME(D.FRST_RGTR_ID)) AS FRST_RGTR_NM, D.FRST_REG_DT, G.INST_NM, G.INST_TYPE_SE_CD, G.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD, H.AUTHRT_SE_CD
FROM SAB930 D /* 접속로그 */ LEFT JOIN SAA200 E /* 사용자 */ ON E.USER_ID = D.FRST_RGTR_ID LEFT JOIN SCA100 F /* 종사자 */ ON F.ENFSN_NO = E.ENFSN_NO LEFT JOIN SAA000 G /* 통합기관 */ ON G.INST_NO = F.OGDP_INST_NO LEFT JOIN SAB230 H /* 사용자별기관권한 */ ON H.USER_ID = E.USER_ID
WHERE MNGR_YN = 'Y'
) C
AND C.CNTN_IP_ADDR LIKE '%' || #{CNTN_IP_ADDR} || '%'
AND C.LGN_LGT_SE_CD = #{LGN_LGT_SE_CD}
AND C.FRST_RGTR_ID LIKE '%' || #{FRST_RGTR_ID} || '%'
AND C.FRST_RGTR_NM LIKE '%' || #{FRST_RGTR_NM} || '%'
AND C.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DATE} || ' 00:00:00', 'YYYYMMDD HH24:MI:SS')
AND C.FRST_REG_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DATE} || ' 23:59:59', 'YYYYMMDD HH24:MI:SS')
AND C.INST_NM LIKE '%' || #{INST_NM} || '%'
AND C.INST_TYPE_SE_CD = #{INST_TYPE_SE_CD}
AND C.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD}

/* selectLogInOutLog - Lee JiSeob */
SELECT
SEQ, CNTN_IP_ADDR, LGN_LGT_SE_CD, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_RGTR_NM, LGN_SCS_YN,
TO_CHAR(FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS FRST_REG_DT,
INST_NM, INST_TYPE_SE_CD, UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD, AUTHRT_SE_CD /* 기관명, 기관유형, 단위업무구분코드, 권한 */
FROM ( SELECT
ROWNUM AS SEQ, CNTN_IP_ADDR, LGN_LGT_SE_CD, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_RGTR_NM, FRST_REG_DT, LGN_SCS_YN,
INST_NM, INST_TYPE_SE_CD, UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD, AUTHRT_SE_CD
FROM ( SELECT
CNTN_IP_ADDR, LGN_LGT_SE_CD, FRST_RGTR_ID, LGN_SCS_YN, FRST_RGTR_NM, FRST_REG_DT, INST_NM, INST_TYPE_SE_CD, UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD, AUTHRT_SE_CD
FROM (
SELECT D.CNTN_IP_ADDR, D.LGN_LGT_SE_CD, D.FRST_RGTR_ID, D.LGN_SCS_YN, C##RG.DEC_B64(C##RG.SA_FN_GET_NAME(D.FRST_RGTR_ID)) AS FRST_RGTR_NM, D.FRST_REG_DT, G.INST_NM, G.INST_TYPE_SE_CD, G.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD, H.AUTHRT_SE_CD
FROM SAB930 D /* 접속로그 */ LEFT JOIN SAA200 E /* 사용자 */ ON E.USER_ID = D.FRST_RGTR_ID LEFT JOIN SCA100 F /* 종사자 */ ON F.ENFSN_NO = E.ENFSN_NO LEFT JOIN SAA000 G /* 통합기관 */ ON G.INST_NO = F.OGDP_INST_NO LEFT JOIN SAB230 H /* 사용자별기관권한 */ ON H.USER_ID = E.USER_ID
WHERE MNGR_YN = 'Y'
) C
AND C.CNTN_IP_ADDR LIKE '%' || #{CNTN_IP_ADDR} || '%'
AND C.LGN_LGT_SE_CD = #{LGN_LGT_SE_CD}
AND C.FRST_RGTR_ID LIKE '%' || #{FRST_RGTR_ID} || '%'
AND C.FRST_RGTR_NM LIKE '%' || #{FRST_RGTR_NM} || '%'
AND C.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DATE} || ' 00:00:00', 'YYYYMMDD HH24:MI:SS')
AND C.FRST_REG_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DATE} || ' 23:59:59', 'YYYYMMDD HH24:MI:SS')
AND C.INST_NM LIKE '%' || #{INST_NM} || '%'
AND C.INST_TYPE_SE_CD = #{INST_TYPE_SE_CD}
AND C.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD}
ORDER BY C.FRST_REG_DT DESC ) X1 ) X2 WHERE SEQ >= #{START_IDX} AND SEQ <= #{LAST_IDX}

/* selectErrorLogTotalCount - Lee JiSeob */
SELECT
COUNT(*) AS CNT
FROM ( SELECT
C.LOG_MNG_NO,
(SELECT C##RG.DEC_B64(E.FLNM_ENCPT) FROM SAA200 D, SCA100 E WHERE D.ENFSN_NO = E.ENFSN_NO AND D.USER_ID = C.FRST_RGTR_ID) AS FRST_RGTR_NM
FROM SAB910 C /* 오류로그 */
AND C.URL_ADDR LIKE '%' || #{URL_ADDR} || '%'
AND C.CLSSA_NM LIKE '%' || #{CLSSA_NM} || '%'
AND C.METHDA_NM LIKE '%' || #{METHDA_NM} || '%'
AND C.ERR_MSSAGE_CN LIKE '%' || #{ERR_MSSAGE_CN} || '%'
AND C.MENU_NM LIKE '%' || #{MENU_NM} || '%'
AND C.UP_MENU_NM LIKE '%' || #{UP_MENU_NM} || '%'
AND C.PROGRM_ID LIKE '%' || #{PROGRM_ID} || '%'
AND C.DMND_IP_ADDR LIKE '%' || #{DMND_IP_ADDR} || '%'
AND C.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DATE} || ' 00:00:00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
AND C.FRST_REG_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DATE} || ' 23:59:59', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
AND C.FRST_RGTR_ID LIKE '%' || #{FRST_RGTR_ID} || '%'
AND C.LOG_MNG_NO = #{LOG_MNG_NO}
AND C.ERR_MSSAGE_CN != '세션이 종료되었습니다.'
) X
AND FRST_RGTR_NM = #{FRST_RGTR_NM}

/* selectErrorLog - Lee JiSeob */
SELECT SEQ,
LOG_MNG_NO,
METHDA_NM, ERR_MSSAGE_CN,
MENU_NM, UP_MENU_NM,
FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_RGTR_NM, TO_CHAR(FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS FRST_REG_DT, LAST_MDFR_ID, TO_CHAR(LAST_MDFCN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS LAST_MDFCN_DT
FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM AS SEQ,
LOG_MNG_NO,
METHDA_NM, ERR_MSSAGE_CN,
MENU_NM, UP_MENU_NM,
FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_RGTR_NM, FRST_REG_DT, LAST_MDFR_ID, LAST_MDFCN_DT
FROM ( SELECT C.LOG_MNG_NO,
C.METHDA_NM, C.ERR_MSSAGE_CN,
C.MENU_NM, C.UP_MENU_NM,
C.FRST_RGTR_ID, (SELECT C##RG.DEC_B64(E.FLNM_ENCPT) FROM SAA200 D, SCA100 E WHERE D.ENFSN_NO = E.ENFSN_NO AND D.USER_ID = C.FRST_RGTR_ID) AS FRST_RGTR_NM, C.FRST_REG_DT, C.LAST_MDFR_ID, C.LAST_MDFCN_DT
FROM SAB910 C /* 오류로그 */
AND C.URL_ADDR LIKE '%' || #{URL_ADDR} || '%'
AND C.CLSSA_NM LIKE '%' || #{CLSSA_NM} || '%'
AND C.METHDA_NM LIKE '%' || #{METHDA_NM} || '%'
AND C.ERR_MSSAGE_CN LIKE '%' || #{ERR_MSSAGE_CN} || '%'
AND C.MENU_NM LIKE '%' || #{MENU_NM} || '%'
AND C.UP_MENU_NM LIKE '%' || #{UP_MENU_NM} || '%'
AND C.PROGRM_ID LIKE '%' || #{PROGRM_ID} || '%'
AND C.DMND_IP_ADDR LIKE '%' || #{DMND_IP_ADDR} || '%'
AND C.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DATE} || ' 00:00:00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
AND C.FRST_REG_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DATE} || ' 23:59:59', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
AND C.FRST_RGTR_ID LIKE '%' || #{FRST_RGTR_ID} || '%'
AND C.LOG_MNG_NO = #{LOG_MNG_NO}
AND C.ERR_MSSAGE_CN != '세션이 종료되었습니다.'
ORDER BY C.FRST_REG_DT DESC ) X1
AND FRST_RGTR_NM = #{FRST_RGTR_NM}
) X2 WHERE SEQ >= #{START_IDX} AND SEQ <= #{LAST_IDX}
